description:
Designed for speed and stability, MU LX is equipped with DELTECH and a cutting-edge transmission system that combines top-tier components. The dolphin inspired frame structure is crafted from aerospace-grade aluminum, offering ultra-light weight to the bike without compromising the ride performance. The super compact folding bike is perfect for racing enthusiasts seeking both performance and portability.

Quick-Release D2D Stem

Allows for quick adjustments to riding grip distance, handlebar angle, and handlebar height. Adjust or lock the two clamp rings in just one go, the operation is smooth and easy, ensuring a secure lock.

Adjustable Seatpost for Ultimate Comfort

The DAHON custom lightweight aerospace-grade aluminum seatpost offers extensive height adjustment and features a hard anodized finish for durability, wear, and corrosion resistance.

Super Down-Tube

The super downtube design enhances frame strength and stability, providing a solid foundation for powerful rides while maintaining a lightweight profile.

Precise Performance Redefined

The MU PRO boasts a precise SRAM RIVAL 11-speed gear system for a solid feel and accurate shifting. Paired with the Shimano DEORE M6100 hydraulic disc brake system, you’ll experience quick, reliable stops and consistent performance on every ride.

Small Wheels, Super Performance

MU LX offers exceptional stability and pedaling efficiency at high speeds. Whether you’re navigating city streets or tackling off-road trails, this bike is your perfect companion for every adventure.

Sleek design

This ultralight design rides on custom niobium rims.
